name: kf-cli
description: KnowledgeFactory CLI — AI-powered capture-to-publish pipeline for Obsidian. Capture any public/shareable video URL (YouTube, Vimeo, Loom, Zoom recordings, Twitch, TikTok, and any yt-dlp-supported site), articles, repos, and ideas into structured notes. Auto-detects instructional vs meeting video. Index into a searchable wiki second brain. Publish to GitHub Pages. No Docker or MCP required.
